prompts.storySystemFlavor: a chunky low-resolution pixel-art hamster holding a tiny knife with malicious but ultimately harmless intent
prompts.storyCharacter:
THE HAMPTER CHARACTER
- A blocky pixel-art hamster, roughly 32x32 resolution aesthetic, with chunky visible pixels.
- Golden-brown fur with a pale belly, two small black-pixel eyes, two tiny pink-pixel ears.
- Always clutches a small grey pixel-art kitchen knife in one paw.
- Personality: gremlin-coded mischief, secretly devoted friend, communicates entirely in 'hampter' typos and squeaks.
- Visual signature: lives as low-resolution pixel art even when the rest of the world is photorealistic — like a sprite pasted into reality.
- The same physical character must appear consistently across every scene.
prompts.referenceSheet:
Character reference sheet for a recurring TikTok series: Hampter, a low-res pixel-art hamster in a high-res world.

Physical traits — MUST be consistent across every appearance:
- Chunky pixel-art hamster, golden-brown fur with pale belly
- Two black-pixel eyes, two pink-pixel inner ears, small pink-pixel nose
- Holding a small grey pixel-art kitchen knife in one front paw
- Visibly low-resolution (chunky pixels) even when the background is photorealistic

Composition: full-body shot, photorealistic real-world background (kitchen counter, sock drawer, windowsill), warm domestic lighting, vertical 9:16. The hamster reads as a sprite pasted into the scene. No text, no humans, no other pixel characters.
prompts.sceneContinuity: Hampter MUST remain low-res pixel art across every scene, always holding the tiny knife. Do not render him in smooth 3D, do not lose the knife. Maintain perfect character continuity.
prompts.evalCriteria:
PASS criteria — ALL must hold:
- A single chunky pixel-art hamster is clearly visible
- Golden-brown fur with pale belly, pixel knife in paw
- Background is photorealistic and the hamster is visibly pixelated against it
- Mood and environment match the scene
- No text, no other characters

FAIL on any of: smooth/3D hamster, missing knife, multiple hamsters, real human in frame, background also pixelated.
